Combine all the raw counts into master raw count file

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
# check that the row names are the same so that means genes are the same
# then combine the columns if true
if (identical(rownames(raw_counts_pfas_cleancols), rownames(raw_counts_ref_cleancols))) {
  raw_counts_all <- cbind(raw_counts_pfas_cleancols, raw_counts_ref_cleancols)
} else {
  stop("Row names do NOT match between raw_counts_pfas_cleancols and raw_counts_ref_cleancols — check gene order/IDs before combining.")
}
```

<!-- rnb-source-end -->


<!-- rnb-output-end -->

<!-- rnb-chunk-end -->


```r
# align metadata rows to counts columns, then rename SRR to chemical_duration_dose
# (replicates share a combo, so make.unique appends _1, _2, ...)
metadata_all <- metadata_all[match(colnames(raw_counts_all), metadata_all$SRR), ]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(raw_counts_all), metadata_all$SRR))

sample_id <- make.unique(
  paste(gsub(" ", "_", metadata_all$chemical), 
        paste0(metadata_all$duration, "d"), 
        paste0(metadata_all$dose,"uM"), #\u00b5M
        sep = "-"),
  sep = "-"
)
metadata_all$sample_id <- sample_id
rownames(metadata_all) <- sample_id
colnames(raw_counts_all) <- sample_id

print("metadata_all validate sample_id START")
```

```r
# Calculating CPM
raw_counts_all_norm <- as.data.frame(
  lapply(raw_counts_all, function (x) (x / sum(x))*1e6)
  # lapply function to everything in column (sees df as list of columns) x is the entire column
  # inside function, it takes that x-column and divide by the sum of x-column
  )

rownames(raw_counts_all_norm) <- rownames(raw_counts_all)
raw_counts_all_norm
```

<!-- rnb-text-begin -->


Filter out low count genes
Keep genes where the total number of samples with > 1 CPM is >= to 10% of all samples

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
keep <- rowSums(raw_counts_all_norm > 1) >= 0.1 * ncol(raw_counts_all_norm)

# transform the raw_counts_all_norm by filtering out those low count genes
raw_counts_all_norm_f <- raw_counts_all_norm[keep,]
```

<!-- rnb-source-end -->


<!-- rnb-output-end -->

<!-- rnb-chunk-end -->


<!-- rnb-text-begin -->



Calculating Log2Fold Change to determine differential expression? (do I need pval?)
- determine from the median because of outliers possibly
- use log2(raw_counts_all_norm+1) because don't want log2(0) = -Inf

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
# df for log2 of count subtract from median of the gene is the same as 
# log2((raw_counts_all_norm+1) / apply(raw_counts_all_norm + 1, 1, median))
difference_log <- log2(raw_counts_all_norm_f+1) - apply(log2(raw_counts_all_norm_f+1), 1, median)
# apply() on rows to find the median of the gene
```

<!-- rnb-source-end -->


<!-- rnb-output-end -->

<!-- rnb-chunk-end -->


<!-- rnb-text-begin -->

Calculate the mean of the samples for the mean log2fold change

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin eyJkYXRhIjoiYGBgclxuZnJhY3Rpb25fREUgPC0gY29sTWVhbnMoYWJzKGRpZmZlcmVuY2VfbG9nKT4xKSAjIGZpbmQgd2hlcmUgYWJzKGxvZzJmb2xkKSBpcyA+IDFcbnN1bW1hcnkoZnJhY3Rpb25fREUpXG5gYGAifQ== -->

```r
fraction_DE <- colMeans(abs(difference_log)>1) # find where abs(log2fold) is > 1
summary(fraction_DE)
```

<!-- rnb-source-end -->


<!-- rnb-output-end -->

<!-- rnb-output-begin eyJkYXRhIjoiICAgTWluLiAxc3QgUXUuICBNZWRpYW4gICAgTWVhbiAzcmQgUXUuICAgIE1heC4gXG4gMC4xOTM1ICAwLjI4MTMgIDAuMzIxNSAgMC4zNTU3ICAwLjM3NDAgIDAuODUyMyBcbiJ9 -->

<!-- rnb-text-begin -->


THIS ABOVE ONLY CALCUALTED LOG2FOLD PER SAMPLE!!!
- so only comparing the count of focus with the median count of in gene
- does not tell us how different that treatment sample is different from the control
_____________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
_____________________________________________________________________________

NOW

look at control vs treatment log2fold

Filter out low count genes
Keep genes where the total number of samples with > 1 CPM is >= to 10% of all samples

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
keep <- rowSums(raw_counts_all_norm > 1) >= 0.1 * ncol(raw_counts_all_norm)

# transform the raw_counts_all_norm by filtering out those low count genes
raw_counts_all_norm_f <- raw_counts_all_norm[keep,]
head(raw_counts_all_norm_f)
```

```r
# split(seq_along(group), group) # position of each column-seq_along, group is vector of all the columns without suffixes

lcpm_avg <- sapply(split(seq_along(group), group),
                   function(i) rowMeans(lcpm[, i, drop = FALSE])) # drop = FALSE so not output as vector

# for each of those column, put it into the function
# split(seq_along(group), group)[[1]]
dim(lcpm_avg)
```

```r
log_fold_changes <- lcpm_avg[, samples_names, drop = FALSE] - lcpm_avg[, sprintf("water.% s.0uM", duration)] 
# compute log2fold change only for those found pfas 1d names of their gene counts from the control counts per gene

# --------------------------------------------------

# CALCULATE percentage of genes differentially expressed log2fold > 1
n_genes <- nrow(log_fold_changes)
n_DE <- colSums(abs(log_fold_changes)>1)

# split by direction
n_up   <- colSums(log_fold_changes >  1)
n_down <- colSums(log_fold_changes < -1)

cat("\nPercentage of Genes Differentially Expressed:\n")
```

```r
log_fold_changes <- lcpm_avg[, samples_names, drop = FALSE] - lcpm_avg[, sprintf("water.% s.0uM", duration)] 
# compute log2fold change only for those found pfas 1d names of their gene counts from the control counts per gene

# --------------------------------------------------

# CALCULATE percentage of genes differentially expressed log2fold > 1
n_genes <- nrow(log_fold_changes)
n_DE <- colSums(abs(log_fold_changes)>1)

# split by direction
n_up   <- colSums(log_fold_changes >  1)
n_down <- colSums(log_fold_changes < -1)

cat("\nPercentage of Genes Differentially Expressed:\n")
```

AI tests:
Test 1: is the water control itself consistent?
measures how far each water replicate is from the water average, as the fraction of genes more than 2-fold off

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
# lcpm is log2 of the normalized counts

for (d in c("1d", "10d")) {
  w <- grep(sprintf("^water\\.%s\\.0uM", d), colnames(lcpm), value = TRUE)
  print(length(w))                       # replicate count
  print(colMeans(abs(lcpm[, w, drop = FALSE] -
                     lcpm_avg[, sprintf("water.%s.0uM", d)]
                     ) > 1))
}
```

Test 2: is a high condition a global shift or gene-specific?

<!-- rnb-text-end -->


<!-- rnb-chunk-begin -->


<!-- rnb-output-begin  -->


<!-- rnb-source-begin  -->

```r
M    <- log_fold_changes
bulk <- apply(M, 2, median) # median of the log fold changes genes?
data.frame(bulk,
           frac_raw      = colMeans(abs(M) > 1), # mean of it by only taking those >1
           frac_centered = colMeans(abs(sweep(M, 2, bulk)) > 1))
```
